questions.q: Which food contains genistein, a substance that blocks blood flow to tumors?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says soybeans are high in genistein, which blocks blood flow to tumor cells; ten grams of soy a day is recommended.

questions.q: How much broccoli a week is enough for its cancer-fighting benefits?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a weekly serving of one to two cups brings broccoli's protective effects.

questions.q: Which gut bacteria do cranberries and pomegranate juice encourage?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says cranberries and pomegranate juice encourage Akkermansia muciniphila, which supports immunity and fights inflammation.

questions.q: What happened to telomeres when people ate 10 grams of nuts daily?
a: They lengthened by 8.5 units over a year
They shortened by 15.4 units over a year
They stayed exactly the same for a year
They lengthened by 66 units in a week
questions.why: Lesson 3 reports that a year of eating ten grams of nuts a day increased telomere length by 8.5 units, while normal aging shortens them.
